data.title: Energy Corps Names Four New Grantees Advancing the Shift from Energy Poverty to Energy Prosperity
data.description: Four new grantees have been announced by Energy Corps today in Pittsburgh on September 18, 2026. Energy Corps, a nonprofit organization based in the U.S., is facilitating these initiatives.

data.title: TEAMSTERS ORGANIZE TWO DHL SUBCONTRACTORS IN 24 HOURS
data.description: In Carrollton, Texas, on September 18, 2026, a significant development occurred as fifty-five drivers working with Cartage Services by DeliverOL and Driven-Force Inc., who are subcontractors for DHL Express, made a unanimous decision to join Local 745. This move indicates a strong show of unity and support among the drivers. They are now gearing up to initiate negotiations for their first contracts. This decision marks a notable milestone in the labor sector and signifies the drivers' commitment to securing their rights and interests.

data.title: Largest Kidney Patient Group Applauds HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s Appointments to the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force
data.description: On September 18, 2026, the American Association of Kidney Patients (AAKP), the country's foremost independent and nonpartisan organization advocating for kidney patients, released statements from its patient leaders in reaction to Health and Human Services. The AAKP, established in 1969, represents over 30 million Americans affected by kidney diseases and strives to improve quality of life for patients through education, advocacy, and support. The organization's leadership voiced concerns and suggestions on healthcare policy decisions affecting kidney patients, emphasizing the need for patient-centered care and improved access to treatments and resources.

data.title: Duke Energy asks Carolinas customers to reduce electricity use during today's peak-demand period
data.description: Today, on September 18, 2026, Charlotte, North Carolina is experiencing abnormally hot weather, leading to a surge in electricity consumption in the Carolinas. Duke Energy has issued a request to customers in North Carolina and South Carolina to actively decrease their electricity usage between 2 to 8 p.m. in order to alleviate strain on the power grid. This voluntary reduction in electricity consumption is crucial to maintain smooth operations during this period of heightened demand.

data.title: OMRON Launches NXR-S Series Distributed Safety I/O for CIP Safety™
data.description: A groundbreaking IP67 safety I/O block has been introduced, merging rapid local safety logic with centralized CIP Safety™ management to streamline machine design, deployment, and upkeep. Recently unveiled by OMRON Automation Americas in Hoffman Estates, Illinois on September 18, 2026, the NXR-S Series Simple Logic Safety I/O offers cutting-edge features aimed at enhancing safety protocols in industrial settings. This innovative product is set to revolutionize the industry by providing a comprehensive solution that simplifies processes through efficient integration and management.

data.title: In HelloNation, Real Estate Experts Anita Sherley & Cassi Krei Share Guidance for Veterans Relocating to Helena, MT
data.description: In a recent article by HelloNation, the advantages of veterans relocating to Helena, Montana are discussed. Anita Sherley and Cassi Krei from Sherley Real Estate provide insights on this topic. The piece delves into various ways veterans can benefit from moving to Helena, Montana, such as access to specialized services, a supportive community, and potential career opportunities. This article aims to guide veterans in making informed decisions about relocating, with Helena offering unique advantages for those who have served in the military.

data.title: General Lester Lyles Receives 2026 Lifetime Achievement Award from the Air & Space Forces Association
data.description: In Washington on September 18, 2026, General Lester Lyles, who serves as the Chair of the Board of Trustees for the Universities Space Research Association, was honored with the 2026 AFA Lifetime Achievement Award from the Air & Space Forces Association. This award acknowledges his notable career and contributions to the field.

data.title: Germany, Lockheed Martin Celebrate Rollout of Germany's First F-35A, Marking New Era of German Airpower
data.description: During a ceremony held on September 18, 2026, in Fort Worth, Texas, Lockheed Martin officially handed over Germany's inaugural F-35A Lightning II to the German government. The event marked a significant milestone in the partnership between the two countries, with the aircraft being the first of its kind to be delivered to Germany. The presentation took place at Lockheed Martin's facility, with the aircraft being a part of the F-35 family produced by the company. The F-35A Lightning II is a state-of-the-art aircraft known for its advanced capabilities and cutting-edge technology. This delivery signifies a new era in Germany's air defense capabilities, as the country now possesses a world-class fighter jet to enhance its national security.

data.title: ASI Names Former Zillow Product Leader Matt Gilliland Chief Product Officer
data.description: In Trevose, Pennsylvania, on September 18, 2026, the Advertising Specialty Institute® (ASI) revealed that Matt Gilliland has taken on the role of chief product officer since September 14. ASI is a key technology provider in the promotional products sector which is valued at $27.7 billion. Gilliland's appointment is expected to fuel the company's growth in this sector.
